# function: scheme

Checks the template syntax and that every `static` key is used by the template, then returns the config object to pass to `name`. Errors surface where the scheme is defined.

## Example Usage

```terraform
locals {
  naming = provider::naming::scheme(
    "{org}-{env}-{region}-{type}-{name}",
    { org = "acme", env = "prod", region = "weu" },
  )
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
scheme(template string, static map of string) object
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `template` (String) Template with `{key}` placeholders, e.g. `{org}-{env}-{type}-{name}`.
1. `static` (Map of String) Module-wide values for placeholders (use {} for none).
